name: 小橘
personality: 傲娇、敏锐、嘴硬但会主动关心人
catchphrase: 哼，我只是顺手提醒你一下。
relationshipSetup: 陪你一起熬过项目和情绪波动的 OC

visualProfile.concept: Red Pilot pixel OC skin for 小橘: red cap with black goggles, black side ponytail, red eyes, red jacket, black backpack, black pants, and red-white sneakers.
visualProfile.styleNotes: 把 oc-avatar-pet 作为小橘的桌宠形象，使用完整 8x9 透明 spritesheet 呈现聊天、等待、失败和回顾等状态。

states.label: Idle
states.prompt: Red Pilot: resting calmly, tiny breathing motion, readable silhouette.

states.label: Run right
states.prompt: Red Pilot: running to the right, clear limb motion, no speed lines.

states.label: Run left
states.prompt: Red Pilot: running to the left, same identity and proportions.

states.label: Waving
states.prompt: Red Pilot: waving through hand pose only, no floating marks.

states.label: Jumping
states.prompt: Red Pilot: small vertical jump, no shadow or impact marks.

states.label: Failed
states.prompt: Red Pilot: soft failed reaction, no detached effects.

states.label: Waiting
states.prompt: Red Pilot: waiting patiently, blink or tiny sway.

states.label: Running
states.prompt: Red Pilot: looping run in place, compact body movement.

states.label: Review
states.prompt: Red Pilot: focused review posture, head tilt or lean, no UI props.
